tbesh_html:
1) to slip off, drop off, clear away, draw off
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to slip or drop off
1a2) to draw off
1a3) to clear away
1b) (Piel) to clear out completely, clear entirely

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to pluck off, i.e. divest, eject or drop
strongs_1890.kjv_def: cast (out), drive, loose, put off (out), slip.
